Ekuqaleni uThixo wadala umhlaba nako konke okukuwo. Wadala abantu ngokomfanekiso wakhe - ngenxa yobudlelwane, ngenxa yothando.
Abantu babenobuhlobo noThixo. Kodwa abantu bakhetha indlela yokuvukela uThixo - kwaye oko kuvukela kwabahlula kuye.
Yathi thina abakhetha ukuvukela - kanti uThixo wasithanda kangangokuba wenza icebo lokuphilisa obo budlelwane bwaphukileyo, abuhlanganise kwakhona.

Ngoko uThixo wakhetha uhlanga olunye - uSirayeli. Kwaqala ngendoda enye eqhelekileyo egama linguAbraham, waza uThixo wayithembisa: ngawe, zonke izizwe zomhlaba ziya kusikelelwa. Ngolu hlanga uThixo wayeza kuzisa ukuphiliswa nosindiso kwihlabathi lonke.
Kuba emva kwamakhulu eminyaka, kwakolo hlanga, kweza uYesu. Wazalwa yintombi enyulu; unguNyana kaThixo. Weza kusisindisa ekuvukeleni kwethu, aze aphilise ubudlelwane bethu noThixo.
Kwenzeka ngolu hlobo: uYesu wafa emnqamlezweni njengedini lezono zethu. Ngosuku lwesithathu wavuka kwabafileyo - eboyisa obo bumnyama thina bantu sasibanjwe bubo.
Namhlanje uYesu uyaphila, uhleli ngasekunene kukaThixo. Wonke umntu okholwayo kuye aze amlandele, ubuyiselwa ekhaya kusapho lukaThixo - njengomntwana kaThixo ngokwakhe.
Kwabo bakholwayo, uThixo ubapha uMoya wakhe oyiNgcwele - uThixo ngokwakhe esenza ikhaya lakhe ngaphakathi kwethu, esithuthuzela, esikhokela imihla ngemihla.
Kwaye ngenye imini uYesu uya kubuya kwakhona. Uya kwenza zonke izinto zibe ntsha - kungabikho zinyembezi, kungabikho kufa - aze uThixo ahlale nabantu bakhe ngonaphakade.

Esi sigidimi sizisa ukuphiliswa nokubuyiselwa kuye wonke umntu osikholelwayo - sibuyisela ubudlelwane phakathi kwethu noThixo. Zezi ke iindaba ezimnandi: asiyonto siyisebenzelayo, sisipho esiphiwa nguThixo.
Le yimbono epheleleyo yecebo likaThixo ngoluntu, nendlela azise ngayo usindiso kwihlabathi lonke. Ukusuka apha, siza kuhamba kwakweli bali sisuka ekuqaleni - umzuzu ngamnye, ngokweenkcukacha.
Ekuqaleni uThixo wadala amazulu nomhlaba. Konke akwenzayo kwakulungile.
UThixo wadala abantu ngokomfanekiso wakhe - indoda nomfazi.

Kwaye ukudalwa ngokomfanekiso wakhe kwakuthetha into enzulu: abantu babemele babonakalise isimilo nobume bukaThixo kwindalo yonke. Ngokungafaniyo nayo yonke enye into ayenzileyo, thina sadalelwa ukuba sibe ngumfuziselo wakhe.
UThixo wathi ebantwini: qhamani, nande, niwonge lo mhlaba.
Abantu babehlala noThixo kumyezo ekwakusithiwa yiEden. Wayehambahamba nabo khona - ubudlelwane obungaqhawukanga, ubuhlobo obumnandi phakathi koluntu noThixo.

Embindini womyezo kwakumi umthi omnye, waza uThixo wathi: ningasityi isiqhamo sawo - ukuba niyasitya, niya kufa. Kuba uThixo onothando usoloko esishiyela ukhetho: siyabufuna na ubudlelwane naye, okanye asibufuni? Olo khetho lolwethu.
UThixo wakhangela konke akwenzileyo wathi: kulungile kakhulu. Kwathi ngosuku lwesixhenxe waphumla.
UThixo wayengasidingi - wayesifuna. Abantu badalelwa ubuhlobo noMdali wabo, kwaye ibali livula kwihlabathi elilungileyo apho obo buhlobo buphelele.
Amagama abo bantu bokuqala yayinguAdam noEva. Kodwa ngenye imini, kuloo myezo mhle, kwafika inyoka - yaxoka. Ngelishwa, uAdam noEva balilahla ilizwi likaThixo bakholelwa inyoka - basitya isiqhamo.
Ubuxoki babuhamba ngolu hlobo: yityani esi siqhamo, niya kuba njengoThixo. UThixo akanakuthenjwa - unigodlela izinto ezilungileyo.
Bathe nje ukuba batye, ityala neentloni zazalisa iintliziyo zabo - baza bazifihla. Okokuqala, abantu bamoyika uThixo.
Kanti uThixo weza ebafuna, wabuza: niphi na? Kwaye ngezandla zakhe wabanxibisa.
Xa uThixo wabuza okwenzekileyo, uAdam wagxeka uEva, uEva wagxeka inyoka. Isono siyasahlula nakwabanye abantu.
Ukushenxa emyalelweni kaThixo - siso eso isono. Kwaye isono sabwaphula ubudlelwane phakathi koluntu noThixo.

Oko uThixo wathi kuya kwenzeka, ngelishwa kwenzeka. Wathi mabaphume eEden - kwaye ukususela ngaloo mini kukho ukwahlukana phakathi koluntu noThixo. Kanti wanika isithembiso: ngenye imini uya kufika uMhlanguli.
Nangona yayingabantu abalahla iindlela zikaThixo, uThixo wenza icebo lokubasindisa.
Isono sanda kwihlabathi lonke, yaza intliziyo yomntu yakhwelela kude noThixo.
Kwabonakala kwakusapho lokuqala ngaphandle komyezo: umkhuluwa, uKayin, ezele ngumona, wabulala umninawa wakhe uAbheli. Ukufa kokuqala kweli bali yaba kukubulala.
Xa uThixo wabona ububi boluntu, intliziyo yakhe yaba buhlungu.
Ihlabathi lazala lugonyamelo kangangokuba uThixo wagqiba ukulihlamba ngonogumbe omkhulu. Kodwa kwakukho indoda enye ethembekileyo - uNowa. UThixo wathi makakhe inqanawa enkulu kakhulu.
Nakuloo nto, uThixo akalilahlanga ihlabathi. Wababala uNowa nosapho lwakhe.

NgoNowa uThixo wanika ihlabathi isiqalo esitsha - usapho olutsha loluntu olwalumele luphile ngokulungileyo. Kodwa intliziyo yomntu yahlala injalo. Isono saqala ukwanda kwakhona - isiqalo esitsha sodwa sasinganelanga.
Kamva kakhulu, abantu bahlanganisana ndaweni-nye baqala ukwakha inqaba ukuze bafikelele esibhakabhakeni - babe bakhulu ngaphandle kukaThixo. Loo ndawo yayibizwa ngokuba yiBhabheli.
EBhabheli abantu bazama ukwenza igama labo libe likhulu. Kodwa icebo likaThixo laqhubeka lisiya phambili.
UThixo wabenza bathetha iilwimi ezahlukeneyo - baza abantu basasazeka kuwo wonke umhlaba.
Isono asihlali namntu mnye - siyanda kwiintsapho nakuluntu lonke. Kanti nakuxa ububi bwanda, uThixo waqhubeka esenza ngobabalo: walondoloza usapho lukaNowa, wanika ihlabathi isiqalo esitsha.
Phakathi kwezo zizwe zisasazekileyo - kumnombo kaNowa ngokwakhe - uThixo wakhetha indoda enye: uAbraham, indoda eqhelekileyo evela kwisixeko esithiwa yiUre.
UThixo wambiza uAbraham: ngosapho lwakho, zonke izizwe zomhlaba ziya kusikelelwa.

Kutheni uThixo wakhetha uAbraham? Hayi kuba wayelunge ngaphezu kwabanye. UThixo utyebile enceba, kwaye wayefuna ukusindisa uluntu. Sasimnike zonke izizathu zokusilahla - kanti ngenxa yothando lwakhe olukhulu nesisa sakhe, akasilahlanga.
UAbraham washiya ikhaya lakhe nelizwe lakhe engazi nokuba uya phi. Olo hambo luyimbonakalo yokholo.
Ngobunye ubusuku uThixo wamkhuphela phandle wathi: jonga phezulu ubale iinkwenkwezi - ukuba unako. Ziya kuba ngako oko inzala yakho.
UAbraham wamthemba uThixo - waza uThixo wambalela oko njengobulungisa.

Kodwa kwakukho ingxaki: uAbraham nomfazi wakhe uSara babebadala, kwaye babengenamntwana konke. Isithembiso sasivakala singenakwenzeka. Kanti ngexesha elifanelekileyo kanye uSara wazala unyana - uIsake, ogama lithetha intsini. Kwavela ukuba akukho nto ingenakwenzeka kuThixo.
Ngolu sapho lunye, ibali likaThixo lokuhlangula laqhubeka lisiya phambili.

Impendulo kaThixo kwihlabathi elaphukileyo, ngokumangalisayo, lusapho olunye oluqhelekileyo. Isithembiso sokuba ZONKE izizwe ziya kusikelelwa ngoAbraham kulapho ziqala khona iindaba ezimnandi - kwaye zifikelela naseMzantsi Afrika.

Ekuhambeni kwexesha, usapho lukaAbraham lwakhula lwaba sisizwe esikhulu - isizwe esithiwa nguSirayeli. Kodwa bagqibela kwilizwe elithiwa yiYiputa, waza ukumkani walo wabenza amakhoboka. Iminyaka engamakhulu amane beva ubunzima. Bakhala kuThixo - waza weva.
UThixo wabona ukubandezeleka kwabantu bakhe, wathuma indoda egama linguMozisi ukuba ibakhuphe eYiputa.
Ukumkani waseYiputa wala ukubandulula amaSirayeli. Kodwa ngemimangaliso nezibonakaliso ezininzi uThixo wamnyanzela ukuba abakhulule.
Loo mimangaliso nezibonakaliso zabonisa zonke izizwe ukuba uThixo unamandla ngaphezu kwabo nabuphi na ubukhosi.
UThixo wenza umnqophiso nabo, weza kuhlala kanye phakathi kwabantu bakhe.

Umnqophiso asiso isithembiso nje esilula - sisifungo esinzulu esibophayo esimanya amaqela amabini, njengomtshato. UThixo wathi: ndiya kuba nguThixo wenu, nani niya kuba ngabantu bam. Waza wabanika isikhokelo sendlela yonke yokuphila kwabo.
Kwaye uThixo wayethembekile: njengoko babemlandela, wabanika konke ababekudinga.

Kanti nangona uThixo wabonisa ukuthembeka nenceba enkulu kangaka, uSirayeli waphinda-phinda ukukhetha ukuvukela nokulahla ukhokelo lwakhe. Ngoko sajikeleza isijikelezo esinye: isono, umgwebo nokuqeqesha kukaThixo, inguquko yabantu - nenceba kaThixo ebamkela kwakhona.
UMozisi wakhokela uSirayeli iminyaka engamashumi amane. Emva kwakhe, inkokeli egama linguYoshuwa yaqala ukukhokela abantu.
USirayeli akakhululekanga kuba enamandla - uThixo wagcina isithembiso awayesenzile kusapho lukaAbraham. Uyeva, uyasebenza, kwaye akukho bukhosi bunokuma endleleni yakhe.
Emva kweYiputa, uThixo wangenisa uSirayeli kwilizwe awayelithembisile. Bahlala khona - kwathi ekuhambeni kwexesha bathi: sipheni ukumkani, njengazo zonke ezinye izizwe.

Oyena kumkani wathandwayo kuSirayeli yayiyindoda egama linguDavide. Phambi kokuba abe ngukumkani wayeyinkwenkwana nje eyalusayo - kodwa uThixo wamkhetha, kuba wabona kuDavide indoda entliziyo yakhe ifana neyakhe.
Igorha lotshaba elikhulu egama linguGoliyati laligculela uSirayeli - kodwa uThixo wanika uDavide oselula amandla okuloyisa, waza uSirayeli wabona uloyiso phezu kweentshaba zakhe.
UThixo wamenza uDavide ukumkani, wathembisa: kumnombo wakho kuya kuvela uKumkani obukumkani bakhe bungenasiphelo.

Emva kukaDavide, ookumkani abaninzi balawula uSirayeli kumakhulu eminyaka. Bambalwa ababelungile - kodwa uninzi lwaphila kwisono esinzulu. Banqula oothixo ababuxoki, bacinezela amahlwempu, bakhokelela abantu kude noThixo.

Yayisisijikelezo esibuhlungu. Okwethutyana abantu babehamba noThixo; baze kancinci kancinci bayekelele, baphethukele koothixo ababuxoki; oko kwabasa engcinezelweni phantsi kweentshaba zabo; ekubandezelekeni kwabo babekhala kuThixo - aze abasindise. Kuthi ke, emva kwethutyana, sona isijikelezo siqale kwakhona.

Kwaye kuyo yonke iminyaka yabo kumkani, uThixo waqhubeka ethuma abaprofeti - abantu uThixo abakhethileyo ukuba bathethe amazwi akhe kookumkani nakubantu. Beza nesilumkiso - buyani esonweni, buyelani kuThixo - kwaye beza nethemba.

Abaprofeti bathetha nangethemba. Ngenye imini, batsho, uThixo uya kwenza umnqophiso omtsha nabantu bakhe, sixolelwe ngokupheleleyo isono sabo. Kwaye baxela uMkhonzi kaThixo ozayo owayeza kuthwala isono sabantu, asithwale endaweni yabo.
Ngabaprofeti uThixo wathembisa: ndiya kuninika intliziyo entsha, ndibeke uMoya wam ngaphakathi kwenu.

Kodwa uninzi lwabo kumkani nabantu abazange bamamele. Ekugqibeleni isono savelisa isiqhamo saso: umkhosi wotshaba wathimba ilizwe, baza abantu bakwaSirayeli banyanzelwa ukushiya ilizwe labo. Oku yayikukuqeqesha kukaThixo - ukuqeqesha ababelunyukiswe ngako ngabaprofeti iminyaka.
Wonke ukumkani uyasilela - kwaye yiloo nto kanye ibalulekileyo. Ibali lisiqeqeshela ukulangazelela uKumkani ongcono, obukumkani bakhe bungenasiphelo.
Ngoko isilumkiso sabaprofeti senzeka: abantu bakwaSirayeli bathinjelwa kude nelizwe labo. Amakhaya abo namasimi abo ashiyeka ngemva. Kwakubonakala ngathi lonke ithemba lilahlekile.
Oku kuthiwa kukuthinjwa: imikhosi yaseBhabheli yadiliza iYerusalem, yatshisa itempile kaThixo, yathumba abantu yabasa eBhabheli.
Ngexesha bethinjiwe, uThixo akabalahlanga - hayi kuba babekufanele, kodwa kuba uThixo unenceba engummangaliso, kwaye wayesazimisele ukuzisa usindiso kumhlaba wonke.

Imbali yayiyenze yacaca into enye: thina bantu asinako ukuhlala sithembekile kuThixo ngamandla ethu - ukuvukela kwethu kwakuphinda-phindeka. Sasidinga impendulo eyahlukileyo. Kwaye ngabaprofeti uThixo wathembisa kanye leyo: ndiya kukhupha intliziyo yenu yelitye ndininike intliziyo yenyama, kwaye ndiya kubhala umthetho wam kanye ezintliziyweni zenu.

Umprofeti uHezekile wabona umbono: intlambo izele ngamathambo omileyo. UThixo wambuza - anako na la mathambo ukuphila kwakhona? Waza umphefumlo kaThixo ngokwakhe wazalisa loo mathambo ngobomi, kwesuka kwema inkitha enkulu. Umqondiso wawucacile: kwanentliziyo esele ifana nefileyo, uThixo unako ukuyibuyisela ebomini.

Phakathi kwabathinjiweyo kwakukho umfana ogama linguDaniyeli. Kwelo lizwe lasemzini, naxa umthandazo wawalelwe, waqhubeka evula ifestile yakhe ethandaza kathathu ngemini. Naxa waphoswa emngxunyeni weengonyama, uThixo wamgcina ekhuselekile.

Emva kweminyaka engamashumi asixhenxe, kanye njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe, uThixo wababuyisela kwilizwe labo. Bakha kwakhona isixeko saseYerusalem netempile. Kodwa ngaphakathi wonke umntu wayesazi: esona sithembiso sikhulu sasingekagcinwa.
Kanti balinda: uya kufika nini uMhlanguli othenjisiweyo - uMesiya?

Kodwa kwakungekho mntu waziyo ukuba kuya kwenzeka njani. Abaninzi kuSirayeli babelinde igorha eliza kubahlangula kubacinezeli babo. Impendulo yenyaniso yayinzulu ngakumbi - umhlanguli oza kubakhulula ezonweni zabo. UThixo ngokwakhe wayeza kubuyela etempileni yakhe - anikele ngobomi bakhe ngenxa yobomi nenkululeko yabantu.
Iminyaka engamakhulu amane, kwathi cwaka. Kodwa uThixo wayengasilibalanga isithembiso sakhe.
Ubuthathaka bethu nokungathembeki kwethu akukurhoxisi ukuthembeka kukaThixo. Kumakhulu amane eminyaka ezolileyo wahlala ethembekile - elungiselela olona fikelelo lukhulu kwimbali.
Kwathi ke - emva kolo lindo lude, oluthe cwaka - wazalwa uYesu. Wanikwa nelinye igama: uImanuweli, elithetha ukuthi uThixo unathi.

Kudala phambi kokuzalwa kwakhe abaprofeti babebhalile: siza kuzalelwa umntwana, kwaye uya kubizwa ngokuba nguMcebisi omangalisayo, uThixo onamandla, uYise ongunaphakade, iNkosana yoxolo. Kwakubhaliwe nokuba uya kuzalwa yintombi enyulu - kwaye yenzeka kanye loo nto.
UThixo ngokwakhe waba ngumntu, wenza ikhaya lakhe phakathi kwethu.

UYesu wabonakalisa ngokugqibeleleyo ukuba ungubani uThixo nokuba unjani uThixo. Waziwa ngamagama amaninzi - uLizwi likaThixo, uThixo othe waba yinyama, uNyana kaThixo. Yena ngokwakhe wayedla ngokusebenzisa igama elithi uNyana woMntu - igama elivela kumbono womprofeti uDaniyeli, apho abantu bazo zonke izizwe neelwimi bamkhonzayo.
UYesu wakhulela hayi ebhotwe kodwa kwilali encinci ekuthiwa yiNazarete. Wasebenza, wakwazi ukudinwa, wazazi iinyembezi - ubuqonda ubomi bethu ngaphakathi.
UYesu wavakalisa iindaba ezimnandi zobukumkani bukaThixo, wahamba efuna abalahlekileyo.
Kwakukho umprofeti ogama linguYohane, othunywe nguThixo ukuba alungiselele abantu. Uthe uYohane akumbona uYesu, wadanduluka: khangelani - iMvana kaThixo, esusa isono sehlabathi!
UMdali wangena ngaphakathi kwindalo yakhe. KuYesu, uThixo akathumelanga uncedo ekude - weza ngokwakhe.

Ngobusuku obungaphambi komnqamlezo, uYesu wathandaza emyezweni. Wayekwazi ukubandezeleka okuzayo, waza wacela: Bawo, ukuba ikho enye indlela, susa le ndebe kum - kodwa makungabi kukuthanda kwam, makube kokwakho. Akukho mntu wabuthathayo ubomi bakhe; wayikhetha loo ndlela ngokuzithandela, ngenxa yothando.
Ngemini elandelayo wabanjwa wabulawa - wabethelelwa emnqamlezweni, esona sohlwayo sikhohlakeleyo selo xesha. Kanti konke oko kwakuphakathi kwecebo likaThixo.
Emnqamlezweni uYesu wathwala isono sethu.

Ukufa kukaYesu, ikhuselo letempile lakrazuka lisuka phezulu lisiya ezantsi. Elo khuselo lalisahlula abantu kubukho bukaThixo - ngumbingeleli omkhulu kuphela owayenokungena ngaphaya kwalo, kwaye kanye ngonyaka. Ngoku indlela eya kubukho bukaThixo ivulekile kuye wonke umntu.
Ngosuku lwesithathu uYesu wavuka kwabafileyo. Ukufa ngokwako kwoyiswa.

Apho wawoyisa namandla obumnyama awayebambe uluntu. Sasingaqondanga thina, engaqondanga nawo: umnqamlezo wawulicebo kwasekuqaleni. Wavula indlela yokuba siphinde sihambe enkululekweni nakubudlelwane noThixo.
Ngoku indlela ebuyela kuThixo ivulekile. Ubudlelwane obwaphukileyo buhlanganisiwe kwakhona.
Wayengenasono sakhe - kanti wathwala esethu, ukuze thina sime silungile phambi koThixo. Olu lutshintshiselwano olukhulu.
Ukufa nokuvuka kukaYesu kwenza ukuba sikwazi ukuphiliswa, sibuyiselwe kubudlelwane noThixo.
Emva kokuvuka kwakhe, uYesu wanika abafundi bakhe - abahlobo ababemlandela - uMoya oyiNgcwele, wabathuma kulo lonke ihlabathi.
UMoya oyiNgcwele nguThixo ngokwakhe - ngoku esenza ikhaya lakhe ngaphakathi kwabantu bakhe, ebathuthuzela, ebakhokela indlela.

Ngaphambili, abantu babesiya etempileni ukuze bahlangane noThixo. Ngoku kwenzeke into emangalisayo: abantu bakaThixo ngokwabo, bezaliswe nguMoya wakhe, BAYIYO itempile yakhe. Njengoko sihlanganisana ukumnqula size sithandane, uThixo uhlala ngaphakathi kwethu naphakathi kwethu.
Amakholwa okuqala aphila ubomi kunye - esitya, ethandaza, encedana. Uthando ababenalo omnye komnye lwabonisa ihlabathi elibukeleyo ukuba kukho into eyahlukileyo eyenzekayo.

Kwaye isimemo asizange sime kuSirayeli - ngoku zonke izizwe zibizelwa ukuba zibe ngabantu bakaThixo. AbaseAsiya, abaseAfrika, abaseNtshona - abantu bazo zonke izizwe neelwimi kusapho olunye, belandela uYesu kunye kubomi bozinikelo, uthando nentobelo. Ubomi, ukufa nokuvuka kukaYesu kwalitshintsha ihlabathi - umntu ngamnye, ngamnye ebuyiselwa kubudlelwane noMdali othembekileyo, onobubele nesisa.

Ezo ndaba zimnandi zisasazeke kwihlabathi lonke. EMzantsi Afrika abantu abaninzi balandela uYesu namhlanje - kwaye abaninzi abakamlandeli. Ngoko uThixo uyaqhubeka ethuma abantu ukuba baxele iindaba zakhe ezimnandi. Ibali lisabhalwa.
Ngenye imini uYesu uya kubuya kwakhona, aze uThixo enze izulu elitsha nomhlaba omtsha.
Apho uThixo uya kuhlala nabantu bakhe. Kungabikho zinyembezi, kungabikho kufa - ubudlelwane ngonaphakade.
Eli bali linokuba lelakho nawe. Kholwa kuYesu, ubuye ekhaya.
UYesu unamagama amaninzi eBhayibhileni - unguThixo, othe waba yinyama ukuze ahlale phakathi kwabantu.
Waphila njengokuba siphila thina - kodwa engenasono - kwaye bonke ubomi bakhe basibonisa uthando lukaThixo.
Wabubeka ubomi bakhe ngenxa yethu - esifa emnqamlezweni ukuze ahlawule ixabiso lezono zethu. Ngosuku lwesithathu wavuka kwabafileyo, ekoyisa ukufa ngokwako.
Namhlanje uYesu uyaphila, uhleli ngasekunene kukaThixo. Kwaye usambiza wonke umntu: yizani kum, nonke nina nidiniweyo, nithwele ubunzima - ndiya kuniphumza.
Injongo asikokwazi nje ngaye - kukumazi yena. Amabali angezantsi seso simemo.
Ukusuka apha, siza kuhamba kwibali lakhe sisuka ekuqaleni - ukususela ekuzalweni kwakhe kude kube sekufeni nasekuvukeni kwakhe, umzuzu ngamnye.

Kumakhulu eminyaka phambi kokuzalwa kukaYesu, abaprofeti bakwaSirayeli baxela ngomntu owayeza kufika - babemazi njengoMesiya ozayo. Bamnika amagama amaninzi - uMcebisi omangalisayo, uThixo onamandla, uYise ongunaphakade, iNkosana yoxolo - kwaye babhala ukuba uya kuzalwa yintombi enyulu. Ngoku eso siprofeto sasiza kwenzeka.
Isithunywa sezulu uGabriyeli sathi kuMariya: uya kuba nonyana, kwaye uze umthiye igama elinguYesu.
UMariya wayengeyokumkanikazi - wayeyintombazana nje eqhelekileyo yaselalini iNazarete. UThixo uyakuthanda ukukhetha abantu abaqhelekileyo emsebenzini wakhe omkhulu.

Lakufika ixesha, uYesu wazalelwa eBhetelehem, idolophu encinci. Kwakungekho ndawo yokuba usapho luhlale, ngoko uYesu osandul ukuzalwa wabekwa emkhumbini - ibhokisi yokutyisa izilwanyana. UThixo wakhetha ukungena ehlabathini kweyona ndawo ithobekileyo.
Bevela empuma ekude, izazi zeza zilandela inkwenkwezi. Zaqubuda phambi komntwana zamnika izipho ezixabisekileyo.
Igama elithi uYesu lithetha ukuthi: uya kubasindisa abantu bakhe ezonweni zabo.
Ngobo busuku, izithunywa zezulu - abathunywa bakaThixo - zabonakala kubalusi emasimini kufuphi, zivakalisa iindaba: uzuko kuThixo enyangweni, noxolo emhlabeni! UMhlanguli othenjisiweyo wayezelwe.
UThixo akafikanga enamabhotwe, imikhosi okanye ubutyebi. KuYesu, uThixo weza ngokuthobeka - ukuze aphile phakathi kwabantu bakhe, abelane nobomi babo ukususela kobona busuku bokuqala.

Kwakukho indoda egama linguYohane, abantu bakwaSirayeli ababeyithatha njengomprofeti. UYesu weza kuye emlanjeni wabhaptizwa nguye. Uthe uYesu akuphuma emanzini, kwavakala ilizwi livela ezulwini: lo nguNyana wam oyintanda, endikholisiweyo nguye.
Emva koko uYesu waya entlango, waza apho uSathana wamlinga - ezama ukumtsala kude noThixo neendlela zakhe. Kodwa uYesu akonanga. Wema waqina kuko konke ukulingwa.
UYesu waqala ukubiza abantu abaqhelekileyo ukuba babe ngabafundi bakhe. Abaninzi babo bashiya yonke into ukuze bamlandele, babe naye.
UYesu wema emanzini ecaleni kwaboni - kwaye apho abantu bahlala besilela khona ekulingweni, uYesu woyisa.
UYesu wavakalisa: ubukumkani bukaThixo busondele - ulawulo lukaThixo olulungileyo lwalungena ehlabathini. Guqulani indlela yenu yokuphila, nikholwe ziindaba ezimnandi.
Wabizela kufuphi amahlwempu, abagulayo naboni - kanye abo bantu abanye bebabagxotha. Kwakungekho mntu uphantsi kakhulu okanye ukude kakhulu kuye; ecaleni kukaYesu kwakukho indawo yomntu ngamnye wabo.

Ehleli ethambekeni wafundisa: banoyolo abangamahlwempu ngomoya, kuba ubukumkani bamazulu bobabo. Banoyolo abathobekileyo. Banoyolo abaxolisi. Kanye abo bantu ihlabathi libajongela phantsi, uThixo ubabiza ngokuba banoyolo.
Abantu bazisa abantwana abancinci kuYesu. Abafundi bakhe bababuyisa - kodwa uYesu wathi: bayekeni abantwana beze kum, ningabanqandi. Ubukumkani bukaThixo bobabanjalo.
Ubukumkani bunjengobutyebi obufihlwe entsimini: lowo ubufumanayo uthengisa konke anako ngovuyo ukuze ayithenge loo ntsimi.
UYesu wathi: ubukumkani bukaThixo bunjengembewu yemostade - eyona mbewu incinci, kanti ikhula ibe ngumthi omkhulu, zize iintaka zakhe iindlwane emasebeni awo.
Ubukumkani bukaThixo abuyondawo kwimephu - lulawulo lukaThixo olulungileyo lungena, luthe cwaka njengembewu entshula emhlabeni. Kwaye umnyango walo uvulekela kuqala abona bantu bangalindelekanga.
UYesu wayedla ngokuphuma kusasa ekuseni ukuya kuthandaza yedwa. Abalandeli bakhe bacela: Nkosi, sifundise nathi ukuthandaza.
Wabafundisa: thandazani ngolu hlobo - Bawo wethu osezulwini, malingcwaliswe igama lakho, mabufike ubukumkani bakho.
Siphe namhlanje ukutya esikudingayo. Sixolele izono zethu, njengokuba nathi sibaxolela abo basonayo.
Ungasingenisi ekulingweni, kodwa sihlangule ebubini. Abalandeli bakaYesu kwihlabathi lonke basawuthandaza lo mthandazo nanamhlanje.
Umthandazo asiyontetho ende - kukuthetha noYihlo. Kwaye uThixo uyamamela.
UYesu wathi: celani, niya kunikwa. Funani, niya kufumana. Nkqonkqozani, niya kuvulelwa.
Nangona uThixo enguKumkani wako konke, sinokuza kuye ngesibindi - ngendlela umntwana eza ngayo kuyise. Ngulo umnyango uYesu awuvulileyo.
UYesu waphilisa abagulayo, wanika iimfama ukubona.
Indoda eneqhenqa yeza kuYesu - indoda ekwakungekho mntu uyichukumisayo. UYesu wolula isandla sakhe, wayichukumisa, wathi: philiswa.
Wathozamisa isaqhwithi ngelizwi. Abafundi bakhe babuzana: ngubani na kanye kanye lo?
Ngezonka ezihlanu neentlanzi ezimbini watyisa amawaka.
Ebamba isandla sentombazana encinci eyayifile, wathi: ntombazana, vuka. Yaza yavuka. Nokufa kuyalithobela ilizwi lakhe.
Wahamba nabantu abaqhelekileyo - abalobi, abo kuthiwa ngaboni, abaphukileyo nabagulayo - waza wabaphilisa. Wasibonisa ubunzulu bothando nobubele bukaThixo kuthi bantu baphukileyo.
Imimangaliso asiyomilingo - ziimboniselo. Konke ukuphiliswa, sonke isaqhwithi esithozanyisiweyo, sonke isonka esandisiweyo liifestile ezibonisa ihlabathi njengoko uThixo elifunayo.
Abantu benkolo bakrokra ngoYesu: lo mntu wamkela aboni - ude atye nabo! Ukubaphendula, uYesu wabalisa eli bali. Unyana wathatha ubutyebi bukayise, waya kude, wabuchitha bonke.
Kwelo lizwe likude unyana walamba kangangokuba wayeselungele ukutya ukutya kweehagu. Waza waqonda: nezicaka zikabawo zitya zihluthe. Ndiza kugoduka.
Uthe unyana akufika ekhaya, uyise WABALEKA waya kuye wamwola ngezandla zombini.
Yiyo leyo intliziyo kaThixo: wamkela ngovuyo wonke umntu obuyayo ekhaya.

Kodwa unyana omkhulu wacaphuka: yonke le minyaka ndikukhonzile! Uyise wathi: nyana, konke endinako kokwakho. Kodwa umninawa wakho ubelahlekile, ufunyenwe - besingathini ukungabhiyozi? Ngamanye amaxesha siyakhutyekiswa yindlela uThixo anenceba ngayo - kodwa oko akumnqandi ekuxoleleni nasekuthandeni nabona baphukileyo.
UYesu wafundisa abantu ukuthanda uThixo nokuthanda ummelwane wabo. Omnye umntu wambuza: kodwa ngubani ummelwane wam? Waphendula ngebali.

Indoda engumYuda yayihamba ngendlela elilolo phakathi kwezixeko ezibini - isuka eYerusalem isihla isiya eYeriko. Izihange zayihlasela: zayibetha, zathatha yonke into eyayinayo, zayishiya ecaleni kwendlela iphakathi kokufa nokuphila.
Iinkokeli zenkolo zadlula kuloo ndoda yenzakeleyo. Kodwa umSamariya - umntu wangaphandle - wema wayinyamekela.
Nantsi into eyayisenza eli bali lothuse: ngaloo mihla amaYuda namaSamariya ayedelana. Kwindoda engumYuda eyenzakeleyo, umSamariya wayethetha utshaba - kanti lutshaba olwema.
Wagalela ioli newayini emanxebeni, wayikhwelisa loo ndoda kwiesile lakhe, wayisa endlwini yabahambi - waza wahlawula, ethembisa: nantoni na eyongezelelekayo, ndiya kuyibuyisa.
UYesu wathi: hamba wenze ngokunjalo nawe.
UYesu usibizela ukuthanda kwanabo bantu ihlabathi elisixelela ukuba baziintshaba zethu - abantu abahluke kuthi.
UYesu wathi: wonke umntu oweva amazwi am aze awenze, ufana nendoda elumkileyo eyakhe indlu yayo phezu kolwalwa.
Yafika imvula, zaphakama izikhukula, yavuthuza imimoya - kodwa loo ndlu ayiwanga, kuba isiseko sayo sasiphezu kolwalwa.
Kodwa lowo uvayo angenzi, ufana nesidenge esakhe esantini - sithe sakufika isaqhwithi, loo ndlu yawa ngokuwa okukhulu.
Ngaphandle ezo ndlu zimbini zazikhangeleka zifana. Umahluko wabonakala kuphela xa kwafika isaqhwithi. Iziseko zityhilwa luvavanyo.

UYesu waqukumbela intshumayelo yakhe enkulu ngombuzo: bwakhelwe phezu kwantoni ubomi bakho? Ukuweva amazwi akhe kulungile - kodwa umntu owaphilayo ngokwenene wakha phezu kolwalwa, kwaye loo ndlu iyema xa kufika isaqhwithi.
Akukho luthando lukhulu ngaphezu kokubeka ubomi bakho ngenxa yabahlobo bakho - kwaye yiloo nto kanye uYesu awayenzayo.
Umona weenkokeli zenkolo wamqhubela ekufeni. Kodwa uYesu wayesele etshilo: akukho mntu ubuthathayo ubomi bam - ndibubeka mna ngokwam.
Nangexesha bembethelela emnqamlezweni, uYesu wathandazela kanye abo bantu babembulala: Bawo, baxolele, kuba abakwazi abakwenzayo.

Kumakhulu eminyaka ngaphambili, abaprofeti babebhalile ukuba uMkhonzi kaThixo ozayo uya kungxwelerhwa ngenxa yezono zethu, asithwale yena isono sethu. Emnqamlezweni eso siprofeto senzeka: uYesu wayethwele isono sethu sonke.

Wayezile ukutyhila uthando lukaYise nobukumkani bakhe - kanti samlahla; abantu bambulala. Kodwa asazanga thina, engazanga namandla obumnyama esasiwathobela, ukuba oku kwakuyinxalenye yecebo kwasekuqaleni. Ngokufa kukaYesu, ubukumkani bukaThixo babusiza emhlabeni njengasezulwini.
Izaphuli-mthetho ezimbini zazixhonywe ecaleni kukaYesu. Enye yathi: Yesu, ndikhumbule xa ufika ebukumkanini bakho. UYesu waphendula: namhlanje uya kuba nam eParadesi.
Wathi: kufeziwe. Ixabiso lezono zethu lahlawulwa ngokupheleleyo.
Umnqamlezo wawungeyongozi ephazamise umsebenzi kaYesu - WAWUNGUWO umsebenzi. Akukho mntu wabuthathayo ubomi bakhe; wabubeka yena, uthando luhlawula ixabiso elipheleleyo ngokuzithandela.

UYesu wangcwatywa engcwabeni - umqolomba wokungcwaba ovalwe ngelitye elinzima. Kodwa kusasa ngentsasa yeCawa, xa abafazi ababemlandela beza engcwabeni, ilitye laligrarhuliwe, ingcwaba lingenanto. UYesu wayevukile kwabafileyo.

Omnye wabo, uMariya waseMagadala, wema ngaphandle kwengcwaba elila - wayecinga ukuba kukho umntu othathe umzimba wakhe. Waza uYesu ngokwakhe wema phambi kwakhe. Ngeenyembezi akamqondanga, wada wabiza igama lakhe: Mariya. Ngaloo mzuzu wazi - umfundisi awayembone esifa wayephila, kwaye wayemazi ngegama.

Omnye wabafundi bakaYesu, ogama linguTomas, akazange akwazi ukukholelwa ukuba uYesu uvukile kwabafileyo. Wathi: ndingakhange ndizibone iimpawu zezikhonkwane ezandleni zakhe, andiyi kukholwa. Waza uYesu weza, wema phakathi kwabo, wathi kuTomas: jonga izandla zam - chukumisa ubone. UTomas wadanduluka: Nkosi yam, Thixo wam!
Ngokufa nokuvuka kukaYesu, abantu baxolelaniswa noThixo. Wahlawula isohlwayo sezono zethu, waza woyisa amandla obumnyama awayebambe uluntu.
UYesu ovukileyo wabathuma ke abafundi bakhe: hambani nenze abafundi kuzo zonke izizwe - kwaye khumbulani, ndinani yonke imihla.

Kwathi ke, emehlweni abo, uYesu wenyuselwa ezulwini. Wayebaxelele ukuba balinde esixekweni isithembiso sikaYise - uMoya oyiNgcwele, owayeza kuhlala nabo. Kwaye kulapho liqala khona ibali labalandeli bakhe.
Yonke into imi phezu kwale ntsasa: kuba uYesu evukile, ixabiso lesono lihlawulwe, ukufa koyisiwe, kwaye indlela ebuyela kuThixo ivulekile.
Iintsuku ezingamashumi amane emva kokuvuka kwakhe, uYesu waqhubeka ehlangana nabahlobo bakhe - esitya nabo, ebafundisa ngobukumkani bukaThixo. Wayephila ngokungenakuthandatyuzwa.
Wabanika isithembiso nomsebenzi: lindani eYerusalem ade uMoya oyiNgcwele afike phezu kwenu - niya kwandula ke nibe ngamangqina am, kwesi sixeko, kwilizwe elingummelwane, nakuzo iziphelo zomhlaba.
Kwathi ke, bebukele, wenyuswa, laza ilifu lamsitha emehlweni abo. Izithunywa zezulu ezibini zema ecaleni kwabo zathi: lo Yesu kanye uya kubuya, ngendlela le nimbone esiya ngayo.
Ngoko abangaba likhulu elinamanci amabini kubo balinda kunye kwigumbi eliphezulu - amadoda nabafazi - bathandaza.
Ngexesha abafundi babekunye kwigumbi eliphezulu, iYerusalem yayizele ngabantu ngenxa yomthendeleko wesivuno ekuthiwa yiPentekoste, kukho iindwendwe ezivela kuwo onke amazwe.

Ngequbuliso kwavakala isandi esinjengomoya ovuthuzayo sizalisa indlu, kwaza kwabonakala into engathi ngamalangatye amancinci omlilo ehlala phezu komntu ngamnye wabo. Bonke bazaliswa nguMoya oyiNgcwele.
Baqala ukuthetha ngeelwimi abangazange bazifunde - zaza iindwendwe zeva, nganye ngolwimi lwayo lwenkobe, izinto ezinkulu azenzileyo uThixo.
UThixo uyakuthanda ukuthetha nabantu ngolwimi lwabo - ulwimi lwentliziyo, ulwimi lwenkobe. Usakwenza oko nanamhlanje.

Waza uPetros - umlobi owakhe wamkhanyela uYesu - wema phambi kwesihlwele esikhulu sabantu eYerusalem wabalisa lonke ibali: nambulala nina; uThixo wamvusa; uyiNkosi. Abamameli bahlabeka entliziyweni: masenze ntoni na?
Buyelani kuThixo nibhaptizwe, watsho uPetros, kwaye niya kwamkela sona esi sipho. Ngaloo mini kwakholwa abantu abangamawaka amathathu.
Amakholwa amatsha azinikela kwizinto ezine: imfundiso yabapostile, ubudlelwane, ukuqhekeza isonka kunye, nomthandazo.
Babesitya emakhayeni omnye nomnye ngeentliziyo ezivuyayo. Bathengisa oko babenokukushiya ukuze kungabikho mntu phakathi kwabo uswele.
Izityebi namahlwempu, amadoda nabafazi, abemi nabasemzini babehlala etafileni enye - usapho olungelogazi, kodwa olukaYesu.
Obu bomi kunye kuthiwa libandla. Ibandla alizange libe sisakhiwo; ngabantu abangabakaYesu.
Kwaye imihla ngemihla abamelwane babo babebukele - yaza imihla ngemihla, uThixo wongeza abantu abangakumbi kwinani labo.

Esangweni letempile eYerusalem kwakuhleli isibhadu-bhadu esasisisiqhwala kwasekuzalweni - wonke umntu wayesazi, kuba sasithwalelwa khona yonke imihla. Ngenye imini uPetros noYohane badlula kuso besiya kuthandaza, saza sabacela imali.
Isilivere negolide andinazo, watsho uPetros, kodwa endinako ndikunika kona: egameni likaYesu Krestu waseNazarete, sukuma uhambe. Waza wenjenjalo - ehamba, etsiba, edumisa uThixo.
Abasemagunyeni benkolo bababamba babayalela: ningaphindi nilithethe eli gama.
UPetros noYohane baphendula: gwebani nina ukuba kulungile na ukuthobela nina kunokuthobela uThixo - asinako thina ukuyeka ukuthetha ngezinto esizibonileyo nesizivileyo.
Ibhunga lamangaliswa: la yayingamadoda aqhelekileyo, angafundanga - kwaye baqonda ukuba la madoda ayenoYesu.
Asingabo bonke abasamkelayo isigidimi. Ikholwa eligama linguStefano - elizele lubabalo namandla - larholelwa phambi kwebhunga leenkokeli zenkolo.
Wabalisela lonke ibali labantu bakaThixo, waza wathi: nimngcatshile nambulala oLungileyo. Kuba yayizezi nkokeli zenkolo kanye ezanikela uYesu ukuba abulawe.
Bamxuluba ngamatye. Esifa wathandaza njengeNkosi yakhe: Nkosi, ungasibaleli esi sono kubo. Waba ngowokuqala ukufela uYesu.
Intshutshiso enkulu yaqhambuka ngaloo mini, aza amakholwa asasazeka esuka eYerusalem. Kwakukhangeleka ngathi sisiphelo.
Kodwa naphi na apho asasazeka khona, ayehamba nesigidimi - aza amabandla amatsha avela kwidolophu emva kwedolophu.
Owona mzingeli ushushu webandla yayingumfana ogama linguSawule. Wayehamba indlu ngendlu, erhola amakholwa ewasa entolongweni - kwaye wakuvumela ukubulawa kukaStefano.

Ngenye imini, xa uSawule wayehamba esiya kwisixeko saseDamasko ukuya kubamba amakholwa akhona, ngequbuliso ukukhanya okuvela ezulwini kwabengezela kumjikeleza, waza wawa emhlabeni. Ilizwi lathi: Sawule, Sawule, unditshutshiselani na?
Ungubani na, Nkosi? wabuza. NdinguYesu, lo umtshutshisayo.
Qaphela: uYesu akathanga abantu bam - wathi MNA. Nantoni na echukumisa abantu bakhe ichukumisa yena.

Uthe uSawule akuvuka emhlabeni, akabanga nakubona - ukuhlangana kwakhe noYesu kwamshiya eyimfama. Amaqabane akhe amkhokela ngesandla angena esixekweni, kwaye iintsuku ezintathu wahlala eyimfama, engatyi, engaseli.

EDamasko kwakuhlala ikholwa eligama linguAnaniya. UYesu wathi kuye embonweni: yiya kuSawule. UAnaniya woyika - wayeyazi indlela le ndoda yenzakalise ngayo amakholwa - kodwa wathobela. Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kukaSawule wathi: Mzalwana Sawule, uYesu undithumile ukuze ubone kwakhona, uzaliswe nguMoya oyiNgcwele. Kwangoko uSawule wabona kwakhona, waza wasukuma wabhaptizwa.
Umzingeli waba ngumthunywa. Simazi namhlanje njengoPawulos - owathwala iindaba ezimnandi ukuya kude ngaphezu kwakhe nabani na.
Akukho mntu ungaphaya kokufikelela kukaYesu - kwanolona tshaba lubi lwebandla.
Ngaloo mihla abaninzi babekholelwa ukuba iindaba ezimnandi zezikaSirayeli kuphela - ukuba nabani na ofuna ukulandela uYesu umele aqale abe ngumYuda. UThixo wayeza kuwuvula banzi umnyango.

Kwakukho igosa lomkhosi waseRoma eligama linguKorneliyo - umntu wasemzini, kanti indoda emoyikayo uThixo, ethandaza kuye. Ngenye imini wabona isithunywa sezulu sikaThixo embonweni, saza isithunywa sathi kuye: thumela amadoda kwisixeko saseYopa, uzise indoda egama linguPetros.

Kusenjalo noPetros wabona umbono: ilaphu elikhulu lisihla livela ezulwini, lizele zizilwanyana zohlobo lonke - kuquka izilwanyana abantu bakhe ababengavumelekanga ukuzitya. Ilizwi lathi: sukuma, Petros, xhela utye. Uthe uPetros akwala, ilizwi laphendula: musa ukuthi ayihlambulukanga into uThixo ayihlambululeyo. Oku kwenzeka kathathu.

Kanye ngelo xesha abathunywa bakaKorneliyo bankqonkqoza emnyango, waza uPetros waqonda ukuba uthetha ntoni umbono: wawungengokutya kodwa ungabantu - akukho mntu ungahlambulukanga emehlweni kaThixo. Ngesiko kwakungavumelekanga ukuba angene endlwini yomntu wasemzini, kodwa uPetros wahamba nabathunywa, wangena.
Ngexesha uPetros wayesathetha ngoYesu, uMoya oyiNgcwele wehla phezu kwabo bonke ababemamele - phezu kwabasemzini, kanye njengakubo ekuqaleni.
UPetros wathi: ngoku ndiqonda ngokwenene - uThixo akakhethi buso bamntu, kodwa wamkela abantu bazo zonke izizwe ababuyela kuye.
Akusekho bantu bangaphandle. Akukho sizwe, akukho mzi, akukho qela limi kufuphi noThixo ngaphezu kwelinye - umnyango uvuleke ngokulinganayo, kwaye ukufuphi ngokulinganayo.
Kwisixeko saseAntiyokwe - apho amakholwa abizwa khona okokuqala ngokuba ngamaKrestu - ibandla lalithandaza lizila ukutya.
UMoya oyiNgcwele wathi: ndahluleleni uBharnabhas noSawule, umsebenzi endibabizele wona. Ibandla labeka izandla phezu kwabo labandulula.
Kwaqala ke uhambo: isixeko emva kwesixeko, babalisa ibali likaYesu, beshiya ngemva iintsapho ezintsha zamakholwa.
Kwakukho ubunzima kuyo yonke indlela - intlekisa, ukuxulutywa ngamatye, intolongo. UPawulos wabhala kamva: simele sidlule kwiimbandezelo ezininzi ukuze singene ebukumkanini bukaThixo.
Ukuze ahlale ekufuphi namabandla asemancinci, uPawulos wawabhalela iileta. Ezininzi zezo leta sisazifunda nanamhlanje - zikwiTestamente eNtsha.

Kwisixeko saseFilipi, uPawulos nomhlobo wakhe uSilas babexelela abantu ngoYesu xa babanjwayo babethwa ngeentonga. Baza baphoswa kwelona gumbi lingaphakathi lentolongo, iinyawo zabo zatshixelwa emithini.
Ezinzulwini zobusuku babethandaza becula kuThixo - aza amanye amabanjwa ayemamele.
Ngequbuliso inyikima yashukumisa intolongo; yonke iminyango yavuleka, onke amakhamandela akhululeka.

Umgcini-ntolongo wavuka wabona iminyango yentolongo ivulekile. Eqinisekile ukuba amabanjwa abalekile, warhola ikrele lakhe ukuba azibulale - kodwa uPawulos wamemeza: musa ukuzenzakalisa, sisonke silapha! Engcangcazela, umgcini-ntolongo wawa phantsi phambi kwabo wakhala: ndimele ndenze ntoni ukuze ndisindiswe? Baphendula: kholwa kwiNkosi uYesu, uya kusindiswa - wena nendlu yakho. Kwangobo busuku wahlamba amanxeba abo, waza yena nosapho lwakhe lonke babhaptizwa.
Injongo kaThixo yokusindisa uluntu ayinakunqandwa nayiphi na intshutshiso - amakhamandela ayenokubamba abathunywa, kodwa asoze asibambe isigidimi.
Niya kuba ngamangqina am, watsho uYesu - kude kuse eziphelweni zomhlaba. Kwaye baba njalo - kwanabo babaxelelayo, nabalandelayo emva kwabo.
Isigidimi sawela iintlango neentaba neelwandle, saza saguqulelwa kulwimi emva kolwimi.
Inkulungwane emva kwenkulungwane, amangqina aqhelekileyo asithwala - abarhwebi, oomama, ootitshala, amafama - kwada ngenye imini safika naseMzantsi Afrika.
Namhlanje, abalandeli bakaYesu eMzantsi Afrika bayahlanganisana, bathandaze, bathande abamelwane babo - beyinxalenye yalo lusapho lwaqala kwelo gumbi liphezulu.

Kwincwadi yokugqibela yeBhayibhile, ekuthiwa yiSityhilelo, omnye wabafundi bakaYesu - indoda egama linguYohane - waboniswa isiphelo sebali: isihlwele ekungekho mntu unokusibala, sivela kuzo zonke izizwe, izizwana, abantu neelwimi, simi kunye phambi koThixo. Umntu wakowenu ukuloo mfanekiso.
UThixo usenza phakathi kwezizwe namhlanje oko wayekwenza kwincwadi yeZenzo - ethuma amangqina akhe, esindisa abalahlekileyo nabaphukileyo.
Ukuba ufuna ukulandela uYesu, elinye lawona manyathelo malungileyo onokuwathatha kukufumana abanye abantu abamlandelayo - uluntu lwamaKrestu, oludla ngokubizwa ngokuba libandla.
Ibandla alisosakhiwo; ngabantu. Khangela iqela elithanda uYesu, elifunda iBhayibhile, nelikwamkelayo - lisenokuhlangana kwiholo enkulu, kwigumbi elincinci, okanye ekhayeni lomntu.
Amakholwa okuqala ayehlangana rhoqo: ayenqula, efunda, esitya, ethandaza kunye, kwaye encedana ngamaxesha anzima. Kusenjalo ke ukubonakala koluntu lwamaKrestu oluphilileyo.
IBhayibhile ibongoza amakholwa ukuba angakuyeki ukuhlanganisana, kodwa aqhubeke ekhuthazana - kuba kunye sihlala somelele.

Cela uThixo akukhokelele kuluntu olunjalo. Kwezinye iindawo luncinci, okanye lude lufihlakele - kodwa uYesu wathembisa: apho ababini okanye abathathu behlanganisene egameni lam, ndikhona phakathi kwabo.
Ukulandela uYesu akuzange kwenzelwe ukwenziwa wedwa. Ukususela kanye kusuku lokuqala, abalandeli bakhe bahamba kunye.
UThixo uthetha ngeBhayibhile - kwaye ungazifundela yona ngokwakho. Ungayikhuphela iBhayibhile efowunini yakho ngolwimi lwakho kwiphepha elithi Okungakumbi, okanye uyithenge kwivenkile yeencwadi.
IBhayibhile asiyoncwadi inye - lithala leencwadi elipheleleyo - libhalwe kwiinkulungwane ezininzi, libalisa ibali elinye kuphela: ibali likaThixo noluntu, elikhokelela kuYesu.

Indawo elungileyo yokuqala ukufunda yincwadi kaLuka - ubomi bukaYesu, budityaniswe ngenyameko kwiingxelo zamangqina okuzibonela. Emva koko funda iZenzo, ibali labalandeli bakhe - uze uqhubeke kuyo yonke iTestamente eNtsha.
Emva koko, kuyanceda nokufunda iTestamente eNdala - imbali kaThixo noluntu ukususela kwasekuqaleni, elungiselela indlela kaYesu.

Funda kancinci yonke imihla, kwaye phambi kokuba ufunde, cela uThixo akuncede uqonde. Iapp yeBhayibhile ekwiphepha elithi Okungakumbi inezicwangciso zokufunda ezikhokelayo ezikuhambisa kwiBhayibhile inyathelo ngenyathelo.
Yonke into oyifunde kuBhasaly ziziqwenga zeBhayibhile, zikhutshiwe, zibaliswe kwakhona, zacaciswa. Ibali elipheleleyo likulindile khona.
Umthandazo kukuthetha nje noThixo - ngamazwi akho, ngolwimi lwakho. Akudingi mazwi akhethekileyo okanye ndawo ikhethekileyo; uThixo ukuva naphi na, nangaliphi na ixesha.
Enye indlela eluncedo yomthandazo inamanyathelo amane - ngesiNgesi apela igama elithi ACTS: ukudumisa, ukuvuma izono, umbulelo, isicelo.
Ukudumisa kukubonga uThixo ngenxa yalowo anguye. Ukuvuma izono kukuzivuma ngokunyaniseka izono zakho kuye - sele esazi, kwaye uthembekile ekuxoleleni.
Umbulelo kukubulela uThixo ngoko akuphileyo. Isicelo kukucela - iintswelo zakho neze abanye abantu.

Abalandeli bakaYesu bayamnqula noThixo, kodwa kusenokwahluka kunonqulo olukhe walubona kwenye indawo. Sinqula ngokuculela iNkosi kunye - kwaye ngokulinganayo ngokusebenza nangokuphila bonke ubomi bethu ngendlela emzukisayo uThixo.
Umthandazo asilosiko lweengcali. Ngumntwana othetha noyise okuthandayo ukumamela.
Ukulandela uYesu akuthethi nje ukwazi iimfundiso zakhe - kuthetha ukuzithobela. UYesu wabuza: kutheni nindibiza ngokuthi Nkosi, Nkosi, ningakwenzi endikutshoyo?
Ukuthobela akusoloko kulula. Imikhwa emidala nesono zitsala nzima, kwaye akukho mntu unokuzoyisa ngamandla akhe.
Kodwa nazi iindaba ezimnandi: ungacela uThixo akuzalise ngoMoya wakhe oyiNgcwele - kwaye uya kukunika amandla okuthobela uThixo nokwala isono.
Xa usilela - kwaye wonke umlandeli kaYesu uyasilela ngamanye amaxesha - musa ukubaleka kuThixo. Kuvume kuye, wamkele uxolelo lwakhe, uze uvuke uqhubeke ulandela.
UYesu wayibiza le ndlela ngokuba yindlela emxinwa - kodwa uyihamba nawe, kwaye ikhokelela ebomini.
Awuthobeli ukuze uThixo akuthande. Uthobela kuba sele ekuthanda.
